simple.meaning: some one (i.e. so and so , without giving the name of the person or place)

definitions.short: some one (i.e. so and so , without giving the name of the person or place)
definitions.full: H492. almoni אַלְמֹנִי adjective some one, a certain (name unspoken ); א מְּלֹנִי ׳מְקוֺם 1Sam 21:3 ; 2Kin 6:8 ; ׳פ ׳א alone, of person, = such-an-one, so-and-so Ruth 4:1 .
